status: reviewed references and measured third-party files; no physical verification
method: Three research passes on 2026-09-10: (1) OpenLOCK: Printable Scenery pages, forum threads, the OpenForge OpenSCAD bases (devonjones) vendored with commit, two community re-implementations, and trimesh sections of the OpenForge-vendored clip STLs v3.1/v4.0/v4.3 and of locally rendered OpenSCAD sockets; official PS port templates and the v5.4 clip STL were not obtainable without an account. (2) DRAGONLOCK: Fat Dragon Games pages and free adaptor files, trimesh sections of FDG models (DLU_2x2_Master, Dragonbite_Port, WallBase_1, wall cores, Dragonlock-Openlock-ComboClip-v3) and the OpenForge lock_dragonlock.scad; the standalone free clip v3 STL was not obtainable (store login). (3) Comparable systems: product, forum and repository pages for 26 systems; several vendor and marketplace pages returned 403 and are logged as not retrieved. The full page archive, downloads, measurement scripts and findings.md files stay in var/research/ (local, not committed); this manifest records url, retrieval date and sha256 of each archived file.
